def bfs(start_cells, passable_set):
    from collections import deque
    dist = {}
    q = deque()
    for cell in start_cells:
        if cell in passable_set:

            q.append(cell)
    while q:

        d = dist[cur]
        for nb in neighbors(cur):
            if nb in passable_set and nb not in dist:
                dist[nb] = d+1
                q.append(nb)
    return dist
